topic: Day 18 — carousel — You can't out-give a relationship you're not being honest in

slides.text: Gifts can't substitute for saying the true, uncomfortable thing.
People overcompensate with actions when the deficit is honesty.
No amount of effort in the wrong currency fixes that.

caption:
Generosity can't substitute for the vulnerability of saying the true, slightly uncomfortable thing out loud.

Follow for one of these a day.
